message: NO_TRADE: The complete 18-symbol 13:00 UTC package was valid, FRESH, and MARKET_OPEN. Several instruments broke prior H1 structure, but the qualifying moves were already extended: AUDUSD, XAUUSD, EURAUD, GBPAUD, and USDJPY closed roughly 1–2.2 ATR beyond their levels after large impulse candles. GBPUSD and NZDUSD also lacked a clean non-chasing entry. No setup qualified.
